$comment: Border, focus-ring and focus-ring-offset widths (T514, closes gap DS-4, research D5). A deliberately small, closed family rather than a ratification of Tailwind's built-in border-width scale: FR-062 requires a mechanical check that an off-scale value fails, and Tailwind's numeric width scale is unbounded (`border-7` compiles), so ratifying it would hand the scale checker nothing to enforce. Values name what already ships and do not move: `hairline` is Tailwind's default `border` utility (1px); `ring` and `ring-offset` are the focus ring's `outline-2`/`outline-offset-2` (2px each); `ring-offset-inset` is the inward focus ring's `-outline-offset-4` (T586, `Button` primary and `DataExportPanel`'s download link, color-tokens.md §5) — admitted after the fact (GOVERNANCE.md's token admission Record) to name a value that had already shipped as a bare literal, invisible to `scripts/checks/token-scale.mjs`'s bracket/px-rem-ms scan because it carries no unit suffix of its own. `ring-offset-inset-flush` is a second, distinct inward offset, `-outline-offset-2` (T589, `MatchRow`, `FavouritesList`, `PlayerResultRow` and `Menu`'s third ring, DS-11) — not a synonym of `ring-offset-inset` even though both are 2px in magnitude: `ring-offset-inset` (-4px) leaves a band of the `accent` fill between the ring and a control's edge, the geometric condition color-tokens.md §5 states (the inward magnitude must strictly exceed the ring's own 2px width); `ring-offset-inset-flush` (-2px) rings in the ordinary `focus-ring` role against a row or menu item's own edge, where the requirement is only that the ring never crops the row's content or bleeds into a sibling row, so the offset sits exactly flush with the edge (magnitude equal to, not exceeding, the ring's width) rather than leaving a band. Admitted after the fact, the same way `ring-offset-inset` was (GOVERNANCE.md's token admission Record). Adding this fifth member does not move the four above: none of their values changed, and `ring-offset-inset-flush` itself names a magnitude that was already rendering, not a new one. The family now names everything that ships in this namespace: `scripts/checks/token-scale.mjs` scans the whole `outline-offset-N` namespace (bare, any sign) as of T589, so a future bare offset fails the check instead of shipping unnoticed. Consumed through the `border-hairline`, `outline-ring`, `outline-offset-ring`, `outline-offset-ring-inset` and `outline-offset-ring-inset-flush` utilities (contracts/token-families.md §2) rather than through Tailwind's own border-width or outline namespaces, because Tailwind v4 exposes no theme namespace for border width, outline width or outline offset the way `--radius-*` exists for radius — verified against the installed `tailwindcss` package's `theme.css`. Edit here, then run `pnpm --filter design-system tokens:build`.
